entries: Changed auto mode for Claude API and Enterprise users, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways, to default to the server-side classifier, which does not charge for classifier overhead (`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` opts out on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways); warns on billed fallback. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing
Added an `Auto mode server` row to `/status` showing whether this session's auto mode classifier runs on the server

title.zh-TW: 自動模式改採伺服器端分類器，省下額外判斷開銷
title.en: Auto mode switches to server-side classifier, saving extra evaluation overhead

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 Claude 在自動模式下處理任務時，現在不必再為背後的判斷多付一筆開銷。⟦這好比無人停車場的車牌辨識，進出時由遠端主機驗證放行且免收手續費，只有切換到人工備援窗口時才會提醒加收費用。⟧針對 Claude API、Enterprise 用戶，以及 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 與各大閘道，自動模式已改為預設啟用伺服器端分類器。此機制不收取分類器的額外開銷；若退回計費的備援流程，系統會主動發出警告。只要輸入 `/status` 指令，即可在新增的 `Auto mode server` 資料列查看目前工作階段是否在伺服器端運行。若在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 或閘道端想退出，將環境變數設為 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` 即可。
body.en: When letting Claude handle tasks in auto mode, you no longer need to pay extra overhead for the underlying evaluations. ⟦It is like license plate recognition at an automated parking lot, where entry and exit are verified and cleared by a remote host with no processing fee, and extra charges are alerted only when switching to a manual fallback booth.⟧ For Claude API and Enterprise users, as well as Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and major gateways, auto mode now defaults to enabling the server-side classifier. This mechanism does not charge for classifier overhead, and the system actively warns if it falls back to a billed process. Simply run the `/status` command to check whether the current session is running on the server in the newly added `Auto mode server` row. To opt out on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or gateways, simply set the environment variable to `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0`.

items.original:
Changed auto mode for Claude API and Enterprise users, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways, to default to the server-side classifier, which does not charge for classifier overhead (`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` opts out on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways); warns on billed fallback. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing
Added an `Auto mode server` row to `/status` showing whether this session's auto mode classifier runs on the server

entries: New local TUI sessions now leave reasoning summaries disabled by default, fixing request rejection by providers that do not support them. Explicit reasoning-summary settings remain respected. (#46467)

title.zh-TW: 本機終端介面預設關閉推理摘要，避免串接服務拒絕請求
title.en: Local terminal interface disables reasoning summaries by default to prevent connected services from rejecting requests

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機開啟本機 TUI（文字使用者介面，在終端機視窗中互動的操作畫面）工作階段時，現在預設不會主動開啟推理摘要。以前若是串接不支援推理摘要的外部模型供應商，傳送請求時往往會直接被對方拒絕並跳出錯誤；現在預設關閉這項功能後，各家服務就能順暢接收對話。⟦這好比向各家合作車隊填寫託運單時，預設先不附帶額外的特殊明細欄位，避免不支援該格式的站所直接拒收包裹，但只要你明確指定要附上清單就依然照辦。⟧若你先前已在設定中明確指定過推理摘要相關選項，既有的偏好設定依然會完全受到尊重與保留。
body.en: When launching a local TUI session in the terminal, reasoning summaries are now disabled by default. Previously, connecting to external model providers that do not support reasoning summaries would often result in rejected requests and errors; disabling this feature by default allows various services to receive conversations smoothly. ⟦This is like filling out shipping waybills for partner courier fleets, where extra custom detail fields are omitted by default to prevent stations that do not support the format from rejecting the parcel, while still including the itemized list whenever you explicitly ask for it.⟧ If you have previously configured explicit settings for reasoning summaries, your existing preferences will remain fully respected and preserved.

items.original: New local TUI sessions now leave reasoning summaries disabled by default, fixing request rejection by providers that do not support them. Explicit reasoning-summary settings remain respected. (#46467)

entries: Added inline Kitty graphics rendering for LaTeX math equations (`$$...$$` and fenced `math`, `latex`, and `tex` blocks) and Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams in the artifact detail viewer, with Unicode ASCII fallback, Left/Right arrow horizontal panning for wide diagrams, and `m` to cycle between Image, ASCII, and Raw views

Improved the `ask_question` interactive prompt with Left/Right arrow navigation between questions, inline previews of confirmed write-in answers, check marks on answered options, and single-step submission on the final question
Improved the CLI startup banner for enterprise accounts to display the active Google Cloud Project ID beneath the signed-in account and plan tier
Improved model API retry responsiveness by capping per-attempt retry backoff at 30 seconds instead of waiting up to 4 minutes between attempts

Improved customization token budgeting by giving user and workspace rules a dedicated 20,000-token budget (cutting oversized rules on newline boundaries and listing over-budget rules by path and description) so large rule sets no longer evict skills, workflows, subagents, or MCP tools
Improved the `/usage` panel by removing the duplicate remaining-quota percentage line beneath each progress bar

Improved the default agent and subagent toolset by retiring the legacy `find_by_name`, `grep_search`, and `list_dir` tools from the default baseline while keeping them available to custom agents that explicitly list them in `tools`

Fixed plugin skill slash commands being double-prefixed (`/<plugin>:<plugin>:<skill>`) when a skill's frontmatter name already includes the plugin prefix, or being shadowed when multiple plugins define skills with the same short name

Fixed plugin upgrades leaving old MCP server and sidecar processes running from deleted install directories, and pruned superseded plugin versions and staging directories from the marketplace cache on startup
Fixed disabled plugins disappearing from the `/plugin` list after enabled-only customization queries, and hardened plugin ID path validation on uninstall
Fixed terminal rendering and Kitty keyboard protocol stack handling on exit and screen clear by upgrading Bubble Tea to v2.0.9

Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs occasionally skipping the background-task waiting notice, logged background SDK tool progress to task log files, and reduced memory usage by cloning truncated command output previews
Fixed starting the CLI unpinning conversations or marking them unread in the desktop app

title.zh-TW: 產出物檢視器支援圖形渲染，數學公式與流程圖直接預覽
title.en: Artifact Viewer Supports Graphics Rendering with Direct Previews for Math Equations and Flowcharts

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中開啟產出物詳細檢視器時，現在能直接看到圖形化數學公式與流程圖。⟦這好比在閱讀數位筆記時，原本只能看到由文字符號拼排的原始代碼，現在翻開內頁就像自動載入高畫質插圖，複雜的方程式與流程圖直接以視覺圖案精緻呈現。⟧新機制在支援 Kitty 協定的終端機中，能直接在檢視器畫面中渲染 LaTeX 數學公式（包括 `$$...$$` 與 `math`、`latex`、`tex` 程式碼區塊），以及 Mermaid 流程圖和循序圖。若終端機不支援該協定，畫面會自動切換為 Unicode ASCII 純文字作為備援。遇到較寬的圖表時，你可以使用左右方向鍵進行水平平移；隨時按下 `m` 鍵，還可在影像、ASCII 以及原始文字三種檢視模式之間循環切換。
body.en: When opening the artifact detail viewer in the terminal, you can now directly view rendered graphical math equations and flowcharts. ⟦It is like reading digital notes where you previously only saw raw code cobbled together with text symbols, but now turning the page automatically loads high-resolution illustrations, presenting complex equations and flowcharts in refined visual diagrams.⟧ On terminals supporting the Kitty protocol, the new mechanism renders LaTeX math equations (including `$$...$$` and `math`, `latex`, and `tex` code blocks) alongside Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams inline in the viewer. If a terminal does not support the protocol, the display automatically falls back to plain Unicode ASCII text. For wider diagrams, you can use the Left and Right arrow keys to pan horizontally. Pressing the `m` key cycles between Image, ASCII, and Raw text view modes at any time.

items.original: Added inline Kitty graphics rendering for LaTeX math equations (`$$...$$` and fenced `math`, `latex`, and `tex` blocks) and Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams in the artifact detail viewer, with Unicode ASCII fallback, Left/Right arrow horizontal panning for wide diagrams, and `m` to cycle between Image, ASCII, and Raw views

title.zh-TW: 提問互動提示操作升級，支援左右換題與自填預覽
title.en: Interactive Question Prompt Upgraded with Left/Right Navigation and Write-In Previews

body.zh-TW: AI 一口氣丟來好幾個釐清問題時，填答畫面現在讓你前後翻題，也看得出哪幾題已經答過。⟦好比填寫多頁的紙本問卷，現在你可以隨時往前翻閱已作答的題目確認細節，手寫補充的欄位會整齊謄在預覽處，已選項目蓋有清楚的勾選標記，翻到最後一頁時按下確認就能一次繳回整份問卷。⟧提示介面現在支援使用左右方向鍵在多個問題之間自由切換與回顧。若選擇自行填寫答案，確認送出後的文字會直接在行內即時預覽；已經完成選取的選項旁會標註勾選符號，讓整體作答狀態一目了然。當你瀏覽到最後一個問題時，直接按下確認即可一步完成整份送出。
body.en: When the AI asks several clarifying questions at once, the answer screen now lets you move back and forth between them and see which ones you have already answered. ⟦Much like filling out a multi-page paper survey where you can flip back to review answered questions, see handwritten supplementary notes neatly transcribed into a preview area, verify answered options stamped with clear check marks, and submit the entire questionnaire in one go upon confirming the final page.⟧ The prompt interface now supports using the Left and Right arrow keys to freely switch between and review questions. If you choose to write in an answer, confirmed text is previewed inline in real time. Answered options display check marks so your response status is clear at a glance. When you navigate to the final question, pressing confirm submits the entire set in a single step.

items.original: Improved the `ask_question` interactive prompt with Left/Right arrow navigation between questions, inline previews of confirmed write-in answers, check marks on answered options, and single-step submission on the final question

title.zh-TW: 自訂規則享有專屬額度，不再擠壓技能與外部工具
title.en: Custom Rules Receive Dedicated Token Budget Without Evicting Skills or External Tools

body.zh-TW: 載入龐大的專案規範與自訂規則時，其他擴充功能不再因為空間不足而被無預警捨棄。⟦宛如整理隨身行李箱時規劃了專屬夾層，即使放入整疊筆記也只會佔用該夾層的專用容量，並在分頁處整齊切齊，絕不會把隨身工具包或精密儀器擠出行李箱外。⟧系統現在為使用者與工作區規則分配了專屬的 20,000 個 token（AI 處理文字的計量單位）預算配額。超出上限的規則會在換行邊界處自動截斷，並透過檔案路徑與描述清楚列出超額清單。這項獨立配額確保了龐大的規則清單不會再擠掉技能、工作流程、子代理或 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）等重要工具。
body.en: When loading extensive project guidelines and custom rules, other extensions are no longer discarded without warning due to space constraints. ⟦Just like designing a dedicated compartment in a travel suitcase where a thick stack of notebooks only consumes that compartment's designated capacity and is trimmed neatly at page margins, preventing toolkits or precision instruments from being squeezed out.⟧ The system now allocates a dedicated 20,000-token budget for user and workspace rules. Oversized rules are automatically truncated at newline boundaries, with over-budget rules clearly listed by file path and description. This independent quota ensures that large rule sets no longer evict essential tools such as skills, workflows, subagents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

items.original: Improved customization token budgeting by giving user and workspace rules a dedicated 20,000-token budget (cutting oversized rules on newline boundaries and listing over-budget rules by path and description) so large rule sets no longer evict skills, workflows, subagents, or MCP tools

title.zh-TW: 預設代理工具組去蕪存菁，舊版搜尋與目錄工具退役
title.en: Default Agent Toolset Streamlined with Legacy Search and Directory Tools Retired

body.zh-TW: 代理一啟動就帶在身上的工具箱，這版拿掉了三個舊的搜尋與列目錄工具。⟦好比隨身維修包將已經被新型工具涵蓋的舊式單一扳手與量尺移出基本標配，讓隨身工具袋保持俐落；但若是特殊任務的作業手冊明確指名，你依然能隨時將它們放回工具箱中。⟧系統改進了工具配置基準線，將舊版的 `find_by_name`、`grep_search` 以及 `list_dir` 工具從預設工具組中淘汰。這項調整能精簡代理預設攜帶的工具清單，避免多餘工具造成干擾。若你的自訂代理依然需要這些舊工具，只要在設定檔的 `tools` 清單中明確列出，依然可以照常呼叫與使用。
body.en: The toolbox agents carry from the moment they start drops three legacy search and directory-listing tools in this release. ⟦Like a portable repair kit removing older single-purpose wrenches and rulers that are already superseded by modern tools, keeping the toolkit nimble while still allowing you to pack them back in whenever a specialized manual specifically demands them.⟧ The system refines the baseline tool configuration by retiring the legacy `find_by_name`, `grep_search`, and `list_dir` tools from the default toolset. This change streamlines the list of tools carried by agents by default, avoiding distractions caused by redundant tools. If your custom agents still require these legacy tools, you can continue calling and using them as usual by explicitly declaring them in the `tools` list of your configuration.

items.original: Improved the default agent and subagent toolset by retiring the legacy `find_by_name`, `grep_search`, and `list_dir` tools from the default baseline while keeping them available to custom agents that explicitly list them in `tools`

title.zh-TW: 外掛程式指令前綴與背景程序修復，升級快取清理更乾淨
title.en: Plugin Slash Command Prefix and Background Process Fixes with Cleaner Upgrade Cache Pruning

body.zh-TW: 外掛裝多了以後，指令名稱互相打架、升級完舊程式還賴在背景，這幾個毛病這版都處理了。⟦彷彿模組化機房在更換新組件時，主控端會徹底關閉舊機台的殘留線路並清空廢棄零件存放區，控制面板也不會因為零件名稱重複而印錯開關代號，停用的模組依然能隨時在總清單中找回。⟧系統修復了外掛技能的斜線指令在設定名稱自帶前綴時會出現雙重前綴（如 `/<plugin>:<plugin>:<skill>`）的錯誤，並解決了多個外掛定義相同簡稱技能時指令遭到遮蔽的問題。外掛升級時，系統不再讓舊的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與 sidecar 行程在已刪除的安裝目錄中持續殘留運作。啟動時也會主動清理市集快取（把下載檔案暫存起來的空間）中已被取代的舊版外掛與暫存目錄。此外，已停用的外掛不會再因只查詢啟用項目的指令而自 `/plugin` 清單中消失，移除外掛時也強化了外掛識別碼的路徑驗證。
body.en: With several plugins installed, command names could clash and old processes could linger after an upgrade; this release deals with both. ⟦Much like swapping components in a modular server room where the controller terminates lingering connections from decommissioned units, clears out obsolete spare parts storage, prevents duplicate part names from printing incorrect switch identifiers on the panel, and still lets you locate disabled modules in the master inventory.⟧ The system fixes an issue where plugin skill slash commands received double prefixes (such as `/<plugin>:<plugin>:<skill>`) when the frontmatter name already included the plugin prefix, and resolves command shadowing when multiple plugins define skills with the same short name. During plugin upgrades, legacy MCP servers and sidecar processes are no longer left running from deleted installation directories. Startup now actively prunes superseded plugin versions and staging directories from the marketplace cache. Additionally, disabled plugins no longer disappear from the `/plugin` list after enabled-only customization queries, and path validation for plugin IDs has been hardened during uninstallation.

items.original:
Fixed plugin skill slash commands being double-prefixed (`/<plugin>:<plugin>:<skill>`) when a skill's frontmatter name already includes the plugin prefix, or being shadowed when multiple plugins define skills with the same short name
Fixed plugin upgrades leaving old MCP server and sidecar processes running from deleted install directories, and pruned superseded plugin versions and staging directories from the marketplace cache on startup
Fixed disabled plugins disappearing from the `/plugin` list after enabled-only customization queries, and hardened plugin ID path validation on uninstall

title.zh-TW: 終端機橫幅顯示企業專案，用量面板去除重複配額文字
title.en: Terminal Startup Banner Displays Enterprise Project and Usage Panel Removes Duplicate Quota Text

body.zh-TW: 兩個常看的畫面這版變清楚了：啟動時的歡迎橫幅，和查額度的 `/usage` 面板。⟦恰似車輛儀表板在重新整合後，頂部狀態欄直接標記當前連接的行車系統專案代碼，底部的油量指示條也移除了重複堆疊的小字，讓關鍵資訊一目了然。⟧企業帳號在啟動命令列工具時，啟動橫幅現在會在登入帳號與方案層級下方，清楚標示當前作用中的 Google Cloud 專案識別碼（Project ID）。同時，`/usage` 用量查詢面板也移除了每個進度條下方重複顯示的剩餘配額百分比文字，讓整體畫面更為清爽緊湊。
body.en: Two screens you look at often got clearer in this release: the startup banner and the `/usage` quota panel. ⟦Much like a redesigned vehicle dashboard that displays the active navigation system project code directly on the top status bar and eliminates redundant stacked fine print beneath the fuel gauge, making key information clear at a glance.⟧ When enterprise accounts launch the command-line tool, the startup banner now clearly displays the active Google Cloud Project ID beneath the signed-in account and plan tier. Meanwhile, the `/usage` panel removes the duplicate remaining-quota percentage text beneath each progress bar, resulting in a cleaner and more compact interface.

items.original:
Improved the CLI startup banner for enterprise accounts to display the active Google Cloud Project ID beneath the signed-in account and plan tier
Improved the `/usage` panel by removing the duplicate remaining-quota percentage line beneath each progress bar

title.zh-TW: 模型重試等待上限縮減至 30 秒，連線異常恢復更迅速
title.en: Model API Retry Backoff Capped at 30 Seconds for Faster Recovery from Connection Failures

body.zh-TW: 模型 API 一時連不上時，你不必再盯著停住的終端機乾等好幾分鐘。以前在觸發重試機制時，每次重試之間的退避等待時間會逐步拉長，單次最長甚至需要等待多達 4 分鐘，導致終端機長時間停滯。⟦這就像撥打客服專線遇忙線時，自動重撥系統改為最多每隔半分鐘重新撥號一次，不再讓你對著話筒乾等數分鐘才重試。⟧現在系統將單次重試的退避等待時間上限嚴格限制在 30 秒，縮短連線遇阻時的等待空檔，讓對話能更快恢復順暢交流。
body.en: When the model API briefly fails, you no longer have to stare at a stalled terminal for minutes. Previously, when triggering retries, the backoff delay between attempts grew progressively longer, taking up to 4 minutes for a single wait and leaving the terminal stalled for extended periods. ⟦This is like calling a busy customer service hotline where the automated redial system now tries again at most every half minute, instead of leaving you waiting on the line for minutes before redialing.⟧ The system now strictly caps the per-attempt retry backoff at 30 seconds, reducing idle waiting intervals during connectivity hiccups so conversations can resume smoothly much faster.

items.original: Improved model API retry responsiveness by capping per-attempt retry backoff at 30 seconds instead of waiting up to 4 minutes between attempts

title.zh-TW: 終端機退出渲染與無頭模式修復，背景日誌與記憶體最佳化
title.en: Terminal Exit Rendering and Headless Mode Fixes with Background Logging and Memory Optimizations

body.zh-TW: 如果你常用 `-p` 讓它在背景自己跑，或習慣在終端機裡清畫面、退出，這幾項修正都跟你有關。⟦好比後台自動化工作站一邊運作，一邊將各個工具的進度即時抄錄進專屬日誌檔案，同時定期整理過長的文件摘要以節省桌面空間，在操作員關閉工作站時也能乾淨還原周邊設備的通訊狀態。⟧系統將 Bubble Tea 框架升級至 v2.0.9，修復了終端機畫面渲染問題，以及在離開工具或清除畫面時 Kitty 鍵盤通訊協定堆疊的處理異常。在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）使用 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行時，修復了偶爾漏掉背景任務等待通知的問題。背景 SDK 工具的執行進度現在會確實記錄至任務記錄檔中，並透過複製截斷的指令輸出預覽來降低記憶體用量。
body.en: If you often run it headless with `-p`, or routinely clear the screen and exit in the terminal, these fixes apply to you. ⟦Like an automated back-office workstation that logs individual tool progress into dedicated log files in real time while periodically tidying up lengthy document previews to conserve desk space, and cleanly restores peripheral communication states when an operator shuts down the workstation.⟧ The system upgrades the Bubble Tea framework to v2.0.9, resolving terminal rendering issues and anomalies in Kitty keyboard protocol stack handling upon exiting the tool or clearing the screen. When running in headless mode using `-p` or `--prompt`, an issue where background-task waiting notices were occasionally skipped has been fixed. Execution progress for background SDK tools is now reliably recorded in task log files, and memory usage is reduced by cloning truncated command output previews.

items.original:
Fixed terminal rendering and Kitty keyboard protocol stack handling on exit and screen clear by upgrading Bubble Tea to v2.0.9
Fixed headless (`-p` / `--prompt`) runs occasionally skipping the background-task waiting notice, logged background SDK tool progress to task log files, and reduced memory usage by cloning truncated command output previews

title.zh-TW: 啟動命令列工具不再影響桌面版對話釘選與已讀狀態
title.en: Starting CLI No Longer Alters Desktop App Conversation Pinning or Read States

body.zh-TW: 以前在電腦上啟動命令列工具時，可能會意外干擾桌面應用程式（desktop app）的狀態，導致原本釘選的對話被取消釘選，或是已讀過的對話被重新標記為未讀。現在這個問題已經修好，啟動命令列工具不會再誤改桌面版應用程式中的對話標記與釘選狀態。
body.en: Previously, launching the CLI on your computer could inadvertently interfere with desktop app state, causing pinned conversations to be unpinned or read conversations to be marked as unread. This issue has now been resolved, ensuring that starting the CLI will no longer unintentionally modify conversation read flags or pinned states in the desktop application.

items.original: Fixed starting the CLI unpinning conversations or marking them unread in the desktop app

entries: **The HTML report is laid out as dashboard cards.** Each section sits in a card of the same shape instead of being split by thin rules, which were hard to follow down a long page. Body text and numbers share one sans-serif face with tabular figures; monospace is kept for the `[usage]>` prefix and the command line at the top. The palette is neutral, token counts are no longer amber, and green is kept for trends and peaks. The four summary cards share one three-row grid, so their numbers line up.

**Chart labels in the HTML report are larger.** Axis labels went from 9px to 12px and legends from .7rem to .8rem, and the hour axis and the heatmap's month and weekday labels grew with them. The old sizes were unreadable on an ordinary screen.

**Switching Claude accounts no longer shows the previous account's quota on Windows.** Claude Code tags the quota it caches in `~/.claude.json` with the account that fetched it and ignores the cache after a switch. usage did not check the tag, and on Windows that cache is the main source of Claude quota. A cache from another account is now skipped. Caches written by older Claude Code versions carry no tag and are still read.

**Report tests pin session start times to UTC.** Six report tests passed only on UTC machines, so CI stayed green while they failed on Windows at UTC+8. Session start times were converted with an inline `.astimezone()` the tests could not replace; that conversion is now `_session_start_text()`, and the fixtures pin it to UTC next to `_entry_date`. Behavior is unchanged. (#144)

**Website visual refresh.** The feature section alternates image and text in three rows (quota for every tool, the HTML report, themes) with the remaining features as two-column cards, and the standalone report section merged into the second row. The pacing section is a paper card, the theme preview sizes its frame to the panel so short panels leave no empty space, and install moved to the end. Nav links, the mobile copy button and footer links have larger tap targets, and panel previews show a static poster until they load, in Chinese on the Chinese pages.

title.zh-TW: HTML 報表改為儀表板卡片，圖表標籤與字體全面放大
title.en: HTML reports redesigned as dashboard cards with enlarged chart labels and typography

body.zh-TW: usage 的 HTML 報表這版換了一套長相，圖表文字也放大到一般螢幕看得清楚。⟦這宛如將連綿漫長的大看板拆解為規格一致的展示卡，外框俐落分明，連同圖表標籤也一併加大，讓參觀者不必貼近螢幕就能看清各項指標。⟧過去整頁報表只靠細線分段，在長頁面中難以辨識段落分界；現在每個區塊都放進同規格的儀表板卡片中。內文與數字統一採用無襯線字體並搭配等寬數字對齊，等寬字體僅留給最上方的指令與 `[usage]>` 前綴。色票改採中性色調， token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數量不再是土黃色，綠色則專門留給趨勢與峰值。上方四張摘要卡共用同一套三列格線，讓數據俐落切齊。此外，圖表軸標籤從 9px 放大至 12px、圖例從 .7rem 放大至 .8rem，時段軸與熱力圖的月份及星期標籤也同步加大，解決了舊版字級在一般螢幕上難以辨識的困擾。
body.en: The usage HTML report gets a new look in this release, with chart text enlarged enough to read on an ordinary screen. ⟦This is like breaking down a continuous, sprawling billboard into uniformly sized display cards with crisp borders, while enlarging chart labels so viewers can clearly read each metric without leaning in close to the screen.⟧ Previously, the entire report relied only on thin rules to separate sections, making division boundaries hard to follow across a long page; now each section sits in a dashboard card of the same specification. Body text and numbers uniformly share a sans-serif typeface paired with tabular figures, with monospace reserved only for the command line at the top and the `[usage]>` prefix. The color palette adopts neutral tones, token counts are no longer amber, and green is dedicated to trends and peaks. The four summary cards at the top share a single three-row grid, keeping the numbers neatly aligned. In addition, chart axis labels were enlarged from 9px to 12px, legends grew from .7rem to .8rem, and the hour axis alongside the heatmap's month and weekday labels were also enlarged, resolving the issue where older font sizes were unreadable on ordinary screens.

title.zh-TW: Windows 切換 Claude 帳號不再顯示舊額度，自動略過不符身分的快取
title.en: Switching Claude accounts on Windows no longer displays previous quota, automatically skipping mismatched cached data

body.zh-TW: 若是你在 Windows 系統切換 Claude 帳號，查詢到的用量額度現在會即時對應目前登入的身分。 Claude Code 會在 `~/.claude.json` 檔案中將額度快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）標註抓取時的帳號名稱，一旦切換帳號就會忽略該筆暫存。過去 usage 讀取資料時未比對帳號標籤，而 Windows 環境下的 Claude 額度主要仰賴這份快取檔案，導致切換帳號後仍持續顯示前一個帳號的剩餘額度。現在只要帳號不符就會主動略過暫存快取；至於舊版 Claude Code 寫入、未附帶帳號標籤的快取，則照舊讀取不受影響。⟦這做法就像門禁系統在換人感應時重新比對名牌，一旦身分不同便略過櫃檯的暫存資料，不再把前一位訪客的額度誤套給新進人員。⟧
body.en: When switching Claude accounts on Windows, the retrieved usage quota now immediately corresponds to the currently logged-in identity. Claude Code tags the quota cached in `~/.claude.json` with the account name that fetched it, ignoring that cached data once the account switches. Previously, usage did not verify the account tag when reading data, and Claude quota on Windows primarily relies on this cache file, causing it to continuously display the remaining quota of the previous account after switching. Now, any cache with a mismatched account is actively skipped; caches written by older versions of Claude Code without account tags are still read as usual without being affected. ⟦This is like an access control system re-verifying name badges when a new person badges in, bypassing the front desk's cached records whenever the identity differs, so a previous visitor's quota is no longer mistakenly assigned to a newcomer.⟧

items.original: **Switching Claude accounts no longer shows the previous account's quota on Windows.** Claude Code tags the quota it caches in `~/.claude.json` with the account that fetched it and ignores the cache after a switch. usage did not check the tag, and on Windows that cache is the main source of Claude quota. A cache from another account is now skipped. Caches written by older Claude Code versions carry no tag and are still read.

title.zh-TW: 報表測試將工作階段時間固定為 UTC，排除時區差異導致的驗證失敗
title.en: Report tests pin session start times to UTC, eliminating test failures caused by time zone differences

body.zh-TW: 跨不同時區執行開發與報表測試，驗證邏輯不再因本機電腦的時差而產生誤判。過去有 6 支報表測試只能在時區為 UTC 的機器上通過，導致持續整合（CI，自動執行程式測試與建置的驗證機制）維持綠燈，但在時區為 UTC+8 的 Windows 電腦上卻固定失敗。問題出在程式先前直接呼叫 `.astimezone()` 轉換工作階段開始時間，測試環境無法攔截替換該函式。現在該轉換邏輯已獨立抽成 `_session_start_text()` 輔助函式，測試設定便能像 `_entry_date` 一樣將時間固定為 UTC，在維持原有功能行為不變的前提下修正了測試環境差異。⟦此舉如同跨國線上測驗將所有試卷的時間戳記一律對齊標準時區，確保各地評分系統都以同一把尺完成驗證。⟧
body.en: When running development and report tests across different time zones, verification logic no longer misjudges results due to local clock differences. Previously, 6 report tests passed only on machines set to the UTC time zone, allowing continuous integration (CI) to remain green while consistently failing on Windows machines in UTC+8. The issue occurred because the code previously called `.astimezone()` inline to convert session start times, preventing test environments from intercepting and replacing the function. That conversion logic has now been extracted into a separate `_session_start_text()` helper function, enabling test fixtures to pin the time to UTC just like `_entry_date`, resolving test environment discrepancies while keeping existing functional behavior unchanged. ⟦This is like an international online exam standardizing all test timestamps to a single reference time zone, ensuring scoring systems everywhere grade against the exact same baseline.⟧

items.original: **Report tests pin session start times to UTC.** Six report tests passed only on UTC machines, so CI stayed green while they failed on Windows at UTC+8. Session start times were converted with an inline `.astimezone()` the tests could not replace; that conversion is now `_session_start_text()`, and the fixtures pin it to UTC next to `_entry_date`. Behavior is unchanged. (#144)

title.zh-TW: 官網視覺排版全面翻新，擴大觸控點擊範圍並加入預載海報
title.en: Website visual layout completely refreshed with expanded tap targets and preloaded poster images

body.zh-TW: usage 官網這版重新排版，手機上也比較好點。⟦這種整頓好比將型錄重新編排，主力展示採圖文交錯的大版面，其餘項目化為雙欄卡片，並把按鈕與連結範圍全面拓寬以便點按。⟧首頁功能區改為三排圖文左右交錯呈現，分別介紹各家工具額度、HTML 報表與外觀主題，其餘功能則收納為雙欄卡片，原先獨立的報表專區也一併整併至第二排。進度管家改採紙卡質感呈現，主題預覽外框會隨面板高度自適應縮放，避免較短的面板下方留下多餘空白，安裝說明則移至頁面尾端。導覽列連結、手機複製按鈕與頁尾連結皆擴大了點擊有效範圍，且面板預覽在載入完成前會先顯示靜態海報圖，中文頁面亦對應提供中文海報。
body.en: The usage website has been rearranged, and it is easier to tap on a phone. ⟦This overhaul is like redesigning a product catalog, showcasing main highlights across large alternating image-and-text spreads, organizing remaining items into two-column cards, and broadening button and link tap areas for easier tapping.⟧ The homepage feature section now alternates image and text across three rows to introduce tool quotas, HTML reports, and visual themes, while remaining features are organized into two-column cards, and the previously standalone report section has been merged into the second row. The pacing section now adopts a paper card texture, the theme preview frame dynamically adapts to panel height to avoid leaving extra empty space under shorter panels, and installation instructions have been moved to the end of the page. Navigation bar links, the mobile copy button, and footer links all have enlarged tap target areas, and panel previews display a static poster image until fully loaded, with Chinese pages correspondingly providing Chinese posters.

items.original: **Website visual refresh.** The feature section alternates image and text in three rows (quota for every tool, the HTML report, themes) with the remaining features as two-column cards, and the standalone report section merged into the second row. The pacing section is a paper card, the theme preview sizes its frame to the panel so short panels leave no empty space, and install moved to the end. Nav links, the mobile copy button and footer links have larger tap targets, and panel previews show a static poster until they load, in Chinese on the Chinese pages.

## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: Linux 套件庫全面換用新金鑰，舊安裝需更新金鑰圈
title.en: Linux Package Repositories Switch to New Signing Key, Existing Installs Require Keyring Update

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新或安裝 `gh` 若遇到驗證錯誤，可能是本機尚未登記新印鑑。⟦這好比社區大樓換了新門禁印章，住戶若沒登記新印記，警衛核對舊印鑑就會拒絕放行。⟧ GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與管理軟體的官方倉庫）與個別 RPM 包。它們現在僅以新的 PGP 金鑰（fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`）簽署。若你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前透過官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫安裝 `gh` 且尚未更新金鑰圈（存放信任憑證的鑰匙庫），安裝或升級可能失敗。請依照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換指引更新金鑰圈以排除問題。Windows 與 macOS 使用者，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器及原始碼安裝者，則不受影響。
body.en: If you encounter verification errors when updating or installing `gh` on Linux, your system may not have registered the new stamp yet. ⟦This is like a residential community switching to a new access control stamp; if residents haven't registered the new mark, security checking the old stamp will deny entry.⟧ GitHub CLI's APT and RPM package repositories and individual RPM packages are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`). If you installed `gh` through the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not yet updated your keyring, package installation or upgrades may fail. Follow the official PGP signing key rotation guidance to update your keyring and resolve the issue. Users on Windows and macOS, or those who installed via Homebrew, GitHub Releases, other package managers, or from source, are not affected.

> [!IMPORTANT]

title.zh-TW: 登入驗證碼預設自動複製，省下繁瑣手動步驟
title.en: Authentication Codes Copied to Clipboard by Default, Saving Manual Steps

body.zh-TW:
登入 GitHub 帳號或刷新授權時，終端機現在會自動幫你保管驗證碼，省下一道手動複製手續。過去執行 `gh auth login` 登入或 `gh auth refresh` 刷新權限時，畫面會給出一組要在瀏覽器填寫的 OAuth 裝置代碼（在授權網頁輸入以確認本機身分的驗證碼）。以往得手動反白並複製，現在執行這兩項指令時，預設會主動將代碼複製進剪貼簿，切換視窗直接貼上即可。⟦這好比到櫃檯辦業務時，人員直接把號碼牌遞到你手裡，不必自己拿筆在旁邊抄號碼。⟧ 若想永久關閉此功能，可執行設定指令：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

單次呼叫時若有明確指定剪貼簿選項，依然享有最高優先權。
body.en:
When signing in to your GitHub account or refreshing authorization, the terminal now automatically handles the verification code for you, saving a manual copy step. Previously, running `gh auth login` to sign in or `gh auth refresh` to refresh permissions displayed an OAuth device code to be entered in the browser. While you previously had to manually highlight and copy it, running these two commands now copies the code to the clipboard by default, allowing you to switch windows and paste directly. ⟦This is like visiting a service counter where the staff hands the queue slip directly to you, so you don't have to write the number down yourself with a pen.⟧ To permanently disable this feature, run the configuration command:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options specified for an individual invocation still take highest precedence.
